title: Paradoxa, Emblemata, Aenigmata: Dionysius Andreas Freher (PH357)
shelf_note: Freher's emblem manuscript (Boehmist Christian theosophy, c.1720) is squarely within the library's esoteric scope; no tradition or collection given in the packet to test against.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. Pen numbering of the emblems runs forward across the run (58–60 on p.36, 81–83 on p.45, 135–136 on p.74), consistent with ~2–3 emblems per leaf; no backsteps seen. None of the three pages carries a translation, so a reader gets the Latin mottos untranslated.

other.note: No translation stored for this page; the three Latin mottos are left unrendered for an English reader.

book_verdict: The transcription of the emblem mottos is essentially exact on all three leaves, with sensible image descriptions; the one real slip is the German motto on p.45 normalised to 'Sonnen Licht'. No translations exist for these pages, so the book is readable only to Latinists.
